Notes: THE STARTING TEAM (Anthony, 16 Oct): a fresh game gets 12 of your own players, three per Tier, with random names. The Tier II three are PLAIN STARS (Star = yes): Normal class, no element, no abilities - they only become Lorelei, Unkengeister and so on by being upgraded. Tutorial.give_starting_team puts a Star in the Star Hall and saves the twelve as a ready Match Team, First XI (Tuning starting_team_ready), so the first match can be played at once. ROLE: match or adventure; blank = starting_team_role in Tuning.csv. All twelve are Match players, because the first team needs every one of them. Tuning.csv starting_team names this file.
